text:
chris: deploy-bot paused the subscriptions canary — artifact digest mismatch detected during rollout. canary id=canary-subscriptions-2026-03. Anyone to triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: artifact mismatch. requested: subscriptions v3.1.0 + subchart billing v3.1.1, deployed artifact references billing v3.0.5. 4/40 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. logs: /deploy/logs/1800011000

elaine: on it. quick check: did the chart publisher run after the merge?

sara: looks like the release PR bumped parent to v3.1.0 and noted subchart billing->3.1.1 in description, but release artifacts in S3 still show billing-3.0.5 in Chart.lock. build step might have timed out.

chris: options: (1) immediate manual pin to billing-3.0.5 (fast, keeps current artifact), (2) re-run chart publish to push billing-3.1.1 and re-promote (cleaner), or (3) rollback release. Preferences?

elaine: prefer re-publish. subscription paths touch billing and promo flows; we want artifacts to match git. How long does publish take?

sara: publishing should be ~10-20m if CI is green. I'll coordinate with ops for the artifact repo push.

devops-bot: Reminder: canary lock will auto-cancel in 55m if no action taken. Use annotation `release.redwood/pin-subchart` to hold.

chris: can we pin temporarily until publish completes? We don't want more pods swapping under inconsistent manifests.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Manual pin allowed. To pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-subscriptions-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=billing-3.0.5 --overwrite`. Note: when pinned, deploy-bot will skip artifact digest validation for pinned subchart. Remove pin after publish to resume canary.

elaine: I'll apply the pin and run a `helm diff` between billing-3.0.5 and billing-3.1.1 to confirm no breaking default changes.

elaine: running: `helm show values myrepo/billing --version 3.0.5 > /tmp/v305.yaml; helm show values myrepo/billing --version 3.1.1 > /tmp/v311.yaml; diff -u /tmp/v305.yaml /tmp/v311.yaml`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary paused at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z. Lock expiry: 55m.

oncall-sre: standing by. Recommend holding release window +30m after unpause for verification.

elaine: diff result: only param tweaks — default `replicaCount` increased from 2->3 and `resources.limits.memory` bumped from 512Mi->768Mi. No config keys removed. Feature flags unchanged.

chris: okay safe to publish. @sara can you trigger chart-publisher and add a provenance note? Also add a small release-note snippet about the memory/default replica change.

sara: triggering chart-publish now: `make charts && chart-publisher --repo charts-internal --token $TOKEN`. tagging do-not-ignore for ops approval. ETA ~14m.

chris: elaine, go ahead and pin so we stop churn.

elaine: pinned: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-subscriptions-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=billing-3.0.5 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Received annotation. Pin applied. Canary will not replace pods for pinned subchart.

devops-bot: Ops approval required for chart-publish. Approvers: @sara @ops-admin.\n
ops-admin: approved. publishing allowed.

sara: publish completed. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/subscriptions/3.1.0+sub-billing-3.1.1.tgz sha256: 0123abcd... Promoted to stable artifacts repo.

chris: great. @elaine remove the pin and instruct deploy-bot to resume canary. Also include artifact link in release notes.

elaine: removing pin and unpausing: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-subscriptions-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-subscriptions-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring for 30m. Initial health checks passing.

chris: I'll add release-note: "billing subchart -> 3.1.1: default replicaCount increased; memory default bumped to 768Mi. No API changes. Artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/subscriptions/3.1.0+sub-billing-3.1.1.tgz"

sara: filing CI ticket to harden chart publish step (ticket #2401). Linking this thread.

oncall-sre: watching metrics & error budgets for 30m. Will escalate if error rates spike.

elaine: noted. follow-ups: update release PR with artifact sha and provenance, add canary hold clause to release notes for 30m post-unpause, and add CI guard to fail the promotion if Chart.lock mismatch detected (we currently only warn).

chris: thanks all. closing thread for now — will reopen if rollback required. :white_check_mark:
